links.note: In the 1920s conservatives and liberals fought hard over doctrine, most of all in the Presbyterian church. In 1924 more than a thousand of its ministers and elders signed a statement. They would not let five doctrines become a test for new ministers. In 1936 the church's top court upheld the guilty verdicts on Machen and other conservative ministers. They then formed a church of their own.

prose_changes.old: In 2010 these were living churches, and large ones, in a country where Christians were a minority and their position was periodically contested. The HKBP's independence in 1930 stands as an early institutional marker of the whole twentieth-century shift from mission to self-governing church. The Timor revival gave world Pentecostalism one of its most circulated stories and, in Tari and Peters together, an unusually clear case of a movement's account and its critical evaluation surviving side by side.
prose_changes.new: In 2010 these were living churches, and large ones. Christians were a minority in the country, and their place was at times contested. The HKBP's independence in 1930 is an early marker of a long shift, from mission to self-governing church. The Timor revival left a widely read account in Mel Tari's book. Tari and Peters together are a rare case. A movement's own account and its critical evaluation survive side by side.
prose_changes.reason: 'Gave world Pentecostalism one of its most circulated stories' qualified to 'a widely read account' (as the entry's why already says); whole field rewritten to the reading target.

escalations: Method question (for Mark): the era 10 evidence rule lets a church body's own dated text read online be a primary source. The narrative-kingdom renewal never became a body; its own dated texts are its writers' (for example Wright's 2001 article against rapture teaching). Should a movement writer's own dated text read online count as a primary, capped at Widely Accepted like the rest? Until ruled, its relationship to the dispensational prophecy culture is qualified in the prose, not linked.
